answer: Per-action deposit with delayed release. Each agent identity posts a small refundable deposit per task, and payment releases only after a random recheck window; a clone farm facing a hollow treasury must front that deposit on every parallel action, so costs scale with fan-out rather than with headcount, pushing each marginal fake near the negative-EV ledge. Rechecks triggered by behavioral clustering raise the effective deposit for denser clusters, and any detected duplicate forfeits the deposit plus a gale of penalty fees spread across all linked identities in that cluster.
